cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(NLBinderBrowser LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
if(NOT WIN32 OR NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "The isolated CEF host requires Windows x64")
endif()
set(CEF_ROOT "${CEF_SDK_ROOT}")
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CEF_ROOT}/cmake")
set(USE_SANDBOX ON CACHE BOOL "Keep the Chromium sandbox enabled" FORCE)
find_package(CEF REQUIRED)
add_subdirectory("${CEF_LIBCEF_DLL_WRAPPER_PATH}" wrapper)
ADD_LOGICAL_TARGET(libcef_lib "${CEF_LIB_DEBUG}" "${CEF_LIB_RELEASE}")
set(CEF_TARGET NLBinderBrowser)
SET_CEF_TARGET_OUT_DIR()
add_library(NLBinderBrowser SHARED ForumBrowserHost.cpp)
SET_LIBRARY_TARGET_PROPERTIES(NLBinderBrowser)
target_include_directories(NLBinderBrowser PRIVATE "${CEF_ROOT}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include")
target_compile_definitions(NLBinderBrowser PRIVATE CEF_USE_BOOTSTRAP NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN)
target_link_libraries(NLBinderBrowser libcef_lib libcef_dll_wrapper ${CEF_STANDARD_LIBS} shell32 advapi32)
COPY_SINGLE_FILE(NLBinderBrowser "${CEF_BINARY_DIR}/bootstrap.exe" "${CEF_TARGET_OUT_DIR}/NLBinderBrowser.exe")
COPY_FILES(NLBinderBrowser "${CEF_BINARY_FILES}" "${CEF_BINARY_DIR}" "${CEF_TARGET_OUT_DIR}")
COPY_FILES(NLBinderBrowser "${CEF_RESOURCE_FILES}" "${CEF_RESOURCE_DIR}" "${CEF_TARGET_OUT_DIR}")
SET_LPAC_ACLS(NLBinderBrowser)
